answer_1.quote: We propose a two-stage training approach to enhance VPL generation. First, we adopt retrieval-augmented finetuning, as VPL often reuses subroutines in similar contexts. During both training and inference, we retrieve similar examples from a corpus and incorporate them into the model input to improve generation quality. Second, we apply offline direct preference optimization (DPO) to further guide the model toward accurate outputs.
answer_1.outputs: Ladder Diagrams in XML, JSON, and metaprogram formats

answer_4.quote: To further evaluate the effectiveness of our methods, we conduct human evaluations on a randomly selected 50 test set examples. Due to the dataset's security sensitivity, human evaluations were conducted exclusively by PLC engineers who had authorized access to confidential information. Three experienced LD programmers evaluated the generated code based on functionality and assigned scores on a scale of 1 to 5.
